query: How do I reset my password?
answer: If you've forgotten your password, click 'Forgot Password' on the login screen and enter your account email. You'll receive a reset link valid for 30 minutes. For security, TicketOps never sends your password directly - you'll always set a new one via this link.

query: What security features do you offer and how do I turn them on?
answer: We offer two-factor authentication (2FA) as a security feature. To enable 2FA, go to Account Settings > Security > Enable 2FA, then scan the QR code with an authenticator app like Google Authenticator or Authy.

query: How does billing work on your platform?
answer:
Billing on TicketOps works as follows: 

Each invoice breaks down into three main components: the base plan cost, any add-on seats, and applicable taxes. 

If you change plans mid-cycle, a 'proration adjustment' line item will appear on your invoice. 

Admins can add seats anytime, which prorates the cost for the remainder of the billing cycle. Removing a seat takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle and does not generate a refund for the current period. 

Additionally, there's a 15% discount for annual billing.

query: What happens to my data if I cancel my account?
answer: After cancellation, your data is retained for 90 days in case you want to reactivate, after which it is permanently deleted.

query: I lost access to the email on my account, how do I get back in?
answer: Contact support with proof of account ownership (such as a recent invoice) and our team will manually verify your identity before updating your account email.

query: Can I export my tickets to CSV and also automate that export to happen weekly?
answer:
Yes, you can export your tickets to CSV and also automate that export to happen weekly. 

You can export your tickets to CSV from the Reports tab by clicking 'Export'. 

To automate the export, go to Automation > New Rule > Trigger: Schedule, and set it to run weekly.
